name: What preparation is needed before hardwood flooring installation?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before hardwood flooring installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hardwood flooring installation, the area needs thorough preparation. This includes clearing all furniture and existing floor coverings, ensuring the subfloor is clean, dry, level, and structurally sound, and allowing the new hardwood to acclimate to the home's humidity and temperature for several days. Proper acclimation minimizes wood expansion and contraction after installation. Customers should also confirm that doorways and baseboards can accommodate the new floor height.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation involves clearing furniture, ensuring a clean and level subfloor, and allowing the hardwood to acclimate to your home's environment. This minimizes issues post-installation.
